Vernon Redefines Denim Heritage for Marithé François Girbaud's 2026

SEVENTEEN’s resident style icon brings an effortless streetwear edge to the iconic French-heritage label.

BY HALLYUZINE SEOUL DESK • NOV 25, 2026
THE DOSSIER: KEY FACTS BRIEFING
  • Fact 1: Global partnership features SEVENTEEN's Vernon as the official ambassador
  • Fact 2: Showcases the upcoming 2026 F/W denim heritage and street-casual lineup
  • Fact 3: Blends classic Parisian casual aesthetics with modern Seoul streetwear culture

The Intersection of French Heritage and Seoul Streetwear

Marithé François Girbaud has long been celebrated for its avant-garde approach to denim and understated Parisian cool. As the brand continues to anchor itself deeply within the contemporary Seoul fashion consciousness, its latest campaign elevates the dialogue between classic European heritage and modern Korean street style. The aesthetic language remains rooted in structured utility and relaxed silhouettes, proving that true denim craftsmanship transcends generations and geographical boundaries.

Vernon's Undeniable Global Style Influence

Stepping into the role of global ambassador, SEVENTEEN’s Vernon brings his signature effortless charisma and distinct sartorial viewpoint to the brand. Known for seamlessly bridging high-fashion editorials with a laid-back, authentic aesthetic, Vernon embodies the spirit of the modern consumer. His natural synergy with Marithé François Girbaud transforms staple denim pieces into coveted statements of individuality, resonating profoundly with international fans and trendsetters alike.

Decoding the 2026 F/W Vision

Looking ahead to the 2026 Fall/Winter season, the collection reinterprets traditional washes, oversized outerwear, and archival cuts through a contemporary lens. The curation focuses heavily on tactile textures and versatile layering, cementing the brand's dominance in the global K-style ecosystem. For international enthusiasts tracking the pulse of Seoul fashion, this partnership offers a masterclass in how legacy brands continue to reinvent themselves through visionary artist collaborations.
